step1_figure.circuit_type: Folded-Cascode Op-Amp with Class AB Output Buffer and Gain-Enhancement (GE)
step1_figure.description: The circuit is the folded-cascode op-amp with floating class AB output buffer (Fig. 24.44, page 805) combined with the auxiliary gain-enhancement differential amplifiers with source-follower level shifters (Fig. 24.50, page 809), described as Figure 24.51 on page 808.

open_loop_dc_gain.description: Low-frequency open-loop DC voltage gain with gain-enhancement

equation.formula: A_OLDC,GE = A_OLDC * A_GE = [gmn * (Rocasn || Rocasp) * (gmp + gmn) * (ron || rop)] * A_GE
equation.explanation: The gain-enhancement amplifiers regulate the drain voltages of cascode devices, boosting the effective output impedance of the first stage by A_GE, thereby increasing overall DC gain by A_GE.
equation.assumptions: Small-signal operation; cascode output resistance is boosted by the auxiliary amplifier gain.

sky130_expected.calculation: With Sky130 at VDD=1.8V, un*Cox=270uA/V^2, up*Cox=50uA/V^2, lambda=0.1/V. Unboosted folded cascode first stage gain ~40-48 dB; class AB push-pull second stage gain ~14-18 dB; gain-enhancement amplifier gain A_GE ~18-22 dB. Total A_OLDC,GE = 44 dB + 16 dB + 20 dB = 80 dB (10,000 V/V).
sky130_expected.reasoning: Textbook reports baseline gain around 53 dB boosted by ~21 dB up to 74 dB with GE (page 809). In Sky130 1.8V with L=0.15u-0.3u, typical boosted gain spans 70 dB to 85 dB.

gain_enhancement_amplifier_gain.description: DC voltage gain of the auxiliary gain-enhancement regulating amplifiers (AP and AN)

equation.explanation: Gain of the auxiliary diff-pair level-shifted amplifiers regulating the cascode drains.
equation.assumptions: Matched transistors in auxiliary OTA; symmetric gain assumption A_P = A_N.

sky130_expected.calculation: For I_aux = 10 uA, Vov ~ 0.15 V, gm = 2*Id/Vov = 133 uA/V. ro = 1/(lambda*Id) = 1/(0.1 * 10 uA) = 1 MOhm. ron || rop = 500 kOhm. A_GE = gm * ro = 133 uA/V * 500 kOhm = 66.5 V/V = 36.5 dB (or 18-25 dB with short-channel loading and source followers).
sky130_expected.reasoning: Auxiliary single-stage diff-amps typically provide 18 to 25 dB of boost across PVT.

equation.explanation: The unity-gain frequency of a two-stage op-amp determined by first-stage input transconductance gm1 and Miller compensation capacitor Cc.
equation.assumptions: Miller compensation dominant pole approximation; Cc = 240 fF as shown in netlist.

sky130_expected.calculation: For diff-pair biased at 10 uA per side, gm1 ~ 133 uA/V. Cc = 240 fF. f_un = 133e-6 / (2 * pi * 240e-15) = 88.2 MHz.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Text page 804 reports baseline fun around 100 MHz, jumping to 400 MHz when L is halved. With Cc=240 fF and ~10 uA bias, 80-100 MHz is standard.

3db_frequency.description: Dominant pole corner (-3 dB frequency) of the open-loop response

equation.explanation: Relationship between unity-gain frequency, open-loop DC gain, and dominant pole corner.

sky130_expected.reasoning: High gain enhancement pushes the dominant pole down into the 5-20 kHz region.

phase_margin.description: Phase margin of the open-loop transfer function at unity gain frequency

equation.explanation: Phase margin indicates op-amp closed-loop stability driving Cload = 1 pF.

sky130_expected.calculation: Non-dominant pole at output stage f2 = gm2 / (2*pi*CL). For CL = 1 pF, output stage gm2 ~ 1 mA/V gives f2 ~ 160 MHz. At fun ~ 80 MHz, phase lag from f2 is arctan(80/160) = 26 deg, yielding PM ≈ 90 - 26 = 64 degrees.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Baker states PM is typically designed above 60° for clean settling without excessive ringing.

slew_rate.description: Op-amp slew rate when charging the Miller capacitance and output

equation.explanation: Maximum rate of output change determined by available tail current Iss charging Cc.

sky130_expected.calculation: SR = 20 uA / 240 fF = 83.3 V/us (or limited by folded cascode branch 10 uA / 240 fF = 41.6 V/us).
sky130_expected.reasoning: Tail current of 20 uA with Cc of 240 fF yields high slew rates above 40 V/us.

settling_time.description: Transient settling time for a step input pulse (100 mV to 900 mV)

equation.explanation: Total settling time including large-signal slewing period and small-signal settling.
equation.assumptions: Closed-loop inverting or follower topology driving 1 pF load.

sky130_expected.calculation: Slew period for 0.8 V step: 0.8 V / 60 V/us ≈ 13 ns. Small-signal settling ~ 4 / (2*pi*45 MHz) ≈ 14 ns. Total t_settle ≈ 20-25 ns (down to 5-10 ns for small steps).
sky130_expected.reasoning: Text page 804 indicates clean settling around 5 ns to 25 ns for scaled technologies.

quiescent_supply_current.description: Total quiescent current drawn from VDD under equilibrium

equation.formula: I_DD,total = I_bias + I_diff + I_cascode + I_GE + I_out
equation.explanation: Sum of currents through bias generator (140 uA), folded-cascode branches, gain-enhancement auxiliary OTAs (~60 uA), and class AB output stage.
equation.assumptions: Quiescent DC condition with Vp = Vm = 0.9V.

sky130_expected.calculation: I_bias = 140 uA; diff-amp + cascode branches = 4 * 10 uA = 40 uA; GE amplifiers = ~60 uA; output stage quiescent = ~40-60 uA. Total I_DD ≈ 280 - 320 uA.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Baker explicitly notes bias circuit consumes ~140 uA, and adding GE adds 60 uA (page 809).

power_dissipation.description: Total DC static power dissipation at 1.8 V supply

equation.explanation: Total static DC power drawn from the 1.8 V power supply.

sky130_expected.reasoning: Product of 1.8V rail and ~300 uA total static current.

step3_testbench.description: Complete ngspice testbench measuring open-loop DC gain, GE gain, unity-gain frequency, 3dB frequency, phase margin, slew rate, settling time, quiescent current, and power dissipation.
